title: The only meetings your company needs
description: The only meetings your company needs
transcript: It's pretty funny because once again, going back to, like, who I wanted to be as a company, I used to think that corporations and meetings are like the worst thing in the world and they're incredibly inefficient. Now, I do believe that the majority of meetings that people host or are part of are incredibly inefficient, and I do think that they are useless. However, I do think that there is at least one meeting a week that your leadership team needs to have, the founders need to have, and then one meeting a week that your departments need to have. Anything more than that, I think that you're getting in the way of them doing their job. Anything less than that, and I think that it's not reporting enough for you guys to be making changes. When you're creating the meetings, just a great easy way to understand of who should be there or not is that is everybody on that meeting giving input without you asking? You know what I've realized in some of the meetings is that we'd have an hour long meeting talking about one thing, and there was like five people that couldn't give any input on it. And at that point, you're kind of wasting those five people's time cause they could be out doing other stuff for your business.
